授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 老齢社会学の序論的アプローチから、世界をリードする超高齢化社会・日本に焦点を当て、グローバルの観点からその特性や主な課題について議論します。人口高齢化が文化社会に及ぼす多様な減少や問題を掘り下げ、今後の日本社会のみならず、現在急激な高齢化を迎えている他国のあ代や将来の展望についても論じていきます。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Population aging is one of the most significant trends affecting human societies in the twenty-first century. This introductory course on the sociology of aging, also known as social gerontology, focuses on the impact of population aging on contemporary Japan, which is currently the world’s leading aging society.
The course will begin with an overview, exploration, and analysis of the demographic causes and processes of population aging. It will examine the major socio-cultural, economic, and political consequences and future prospects for contemporary Japan. Throughout the course, discussions will emphasize Japan’s case within a global and international context. Students will learn potential lessons from Japan’s experience with an aging society, including both effective countermeasures and enduring challenges, to help develop possible solutions for other rapidly aging countries around the world.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Aging; Population Aging, Demography; Sociology, Health; Policy; Global
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: This is an all-English course designed originally for international/exchange students. Nonetheless, domestic students, including Japanese students, are strongly encouraged to join, and it’s not required to possess a certain level of proficiency in English to formally enroll in this course. However, if you are not a native English speaker, it’s important to possess a minimum level of English skills necessary to meaningfully participate in and successfully complete this course. This course advises that you possess a minimum TOEFL score of 79 (IBT) or IELTS 6.0.
